intent: Phase 1 macro composition: open-sky ice planet, visible Sentinel Archive objective, glacial perimeter silhouettes and terrain-bound robot infrastructure. No AI, combat or final-tech interaction is claimed here.

placements.purpose: Final-tech destination. The south-facing exterior door aligns with the end of the central route; the rear visually locks into the tower foundation without enclosing the sky.
West/north glacial perimeter makes the deck read as a basin rather than a floating rectangle. It stays outside the main tested route.
East/north glacial perimeter and counterweight to the archive silhouette, kept outside the bridge approach.
Far west ice mass for wide QA views and open-world depth, beyond the primary deck edge.
Far east ice mass to frame the raised bridge and avoid a bare horizon.
Tall glacial silhouette behind the tower, visible above mid-ground facilities.
Tall glacial silhouette balancing the tower skyline from the east side.
Robot-owned cryogenic receiver near the archive approach; adds a distinct high vertical layer.
Outer receiver tying the east refinery/hangar sector into the Sentinel Archive visual language.
